caption: Masters — reference data
vo: Every routing rule, rate, risk weight, approval limit and service level the CRM calculates with lives in one place. That's Masters, and changing them needs no developer.

caption: Sign in as Kevin Lam — CRM Administrator
vo: Kevin Lam, our CRM administrator, looks after them.

caption: One tab per master — each row is an ordinary record
vo: One tab per master, and each row is an ordinary record. Edit, import, export and audit it like any other data.

caption: Masters are data: change a row and the next calculation uses it
vo: Here's the distinction. Masters are data. Change a row, and the next calculation uses it. The Builder is configuration. Fields, forms, stages and workflows.

caption: Website Product Routing: what the client picks on the website
vo: Take website product routing. Whatever the client picks on the website goes to a business unit and a queue, with a first-contact target.

caption: Personal loans get a faster first call from today
vo: Say personal loans should get a faster first call, from today.

caption: New queue name and first contact within 2 business hours
vo: Kevin gives it a new queue name, and first contact within two business hours. It stays Lending, so the same team still gets them.

caption: Saved — no release, no restart
vo: Saved. No release, no restart. The very next personal loan enquiry reads the new rule.

caption: Mélissa Bégué asks about a personal loan on the website
vo: Let's prove it. Mélissa Bégué asks about a personal loan on the website, using the same Get in touch form the website shows. Watch what happens when Mélissa sends it.

caption: Sent — the enquiry is in the CRM
vo: Sent. Routing, scoring and the speed-to-lead clock start the moment it arrives.

caption: On the enquiry: the new queue and the 2-hour first-contact target
vo: On Mélissa's enquiry, the new queue and the two-hour target. Read from the routing rule the moment it arrived.

caption: The speed-to-lead clock now allows 2 business hours, not 4
vo: So the clock allows two business hours, not four. And Sophie Lagesse in Lending is alerted as the deadline nears.

caption: Enquiries that arrived earlier keep the target they were given
vo: Earlier enquiries keep the target they were given. The change applies from the next one on.

caption: The KYC risk score adds up weights from the risk-factor master
vo: Now, KYC. The risk score simply adds up weights from the risk-factor master. Country, PEP, product, channel, occupation, ownership and activity.

caption: A case under screening: risk score 102
vo: Here's a case under screening, scoring one hundred and two. A South African resident, onboarded without meeting in person.

caption: Country risk 25 comes from the Country master
vo: Twenty-five of that is country risk, from the Country master. South Africa is under FATF increased monitoring, the grey list.

caption: Countries (AML risk): a score from 0 to 40 for each country
vo: The Countries master scores every country from nought to forty for AML risk. It's updated after each FATF plenary or sanctions change, and black-listed countries score the full forty.

caption: Compliance decides that remote onboarding carries more risk
vo: Now suppose Compliance decides remote onboarding carries more risk. So the weight for a non face to face channel goes from ten to fifteen.

caption: The case still shows 102
vo: The case still says one hundred and two. Why? Scores are worked out on save, not when a weight changes.

caption: Re-assess the case: open it and save
vo: So, re-assess it. Open and save. At the next edit or periodic review, it reads the current weights.

caption: Risk score 107: +5 from the new channel weight
vo: One hundred and seven. Five more, from the new channel weight. And the rating, EDD and approver all follow the score.

caption: Approval Matrices: who approves a loan, by amount
vo: Approval matrices decide who approves a loan. Up to five million rupees, the Loans Manager. Up to twenty million, the Credit Committee. Above that, the Board.

caption: Each application reads its band from these limits
vo: Each application reads its band from here. A thirteen million rupee loan goes to the Credit Committee.

caption: Service Request Catalogue: every request type
vo: The service request catalogue lists every request type, with its business unit, its service level in business hours, and whether it needs approval.

caption: A partial prepayment: 40 business hours, approval required
vo: A partial prepayment, for instance, gets forty business hours and needs approval. Each request copies these values, and routes the approval to the business-unit head.

caption: Genesis PLR History: the prime lending rate over time
vo: The Genesis PLR history tracks the prime lending rate. Loan pricing and each product's rate from figure use the latest one in effect.

caption: Real Estate Loan: “Rate from” = latest PLR 6.825% + the product margin −0.675%
vo: On the Real Estate Loan product sheet, rate from is the latest PLR of six point eight two five percent, plus a product margin of minus zero point six seven five.

caption: A new PLR row reprices every variable-rate loan and product
vo: A new PLR row reprices every variable-rate loan and product. So add one only after ALCO approves it, with its effective date.

caption: FX Reference Rates: the daily TT board
vo: FX reference rates are the daily TT board. The forex desk publishes it each morning, and it converts amounts to rupees and prices FX quotes.

caption: Collateral Types & Haircuts: lending value and LTV alert levels
vo: Collateral types and haircuts set lending value and LTV alert levels, for every pledge and margin-call check.

caption: Model Portfolios A–E: the target asset mix for each risk profile
vo: And model portfolios A to E set the target asset mix for each risk profile, conservative to aggressive, for wealth mandates.

caption: For this tutorial, restore what we changed
vo: Before we go, let's put things back. Every change to a master stays in the record's history anyway.

caption: Non-face-to-face weight back to 10
vo: The non face to face weight goes back to ten.

caption: Personal Loan routing back to Retail Loans, 4 business hours
vo: Personal loans back to Retail Loans, four hours.

caption: And save the KYC case once more so it reads the restored weight
vo: And one more save on the KYC case, so it reads the restored weight.

caption: Back to 102
vo: Back to one hundred and two. Everything's as it was.

caption: Masters — reference data
vo: That's the idea behind Masters. Change the data, not the system, and the very next calculation uses the new values.
